main.description: Starts pairing a bridge with a community. Called by the bridge, which shows the returned code to an admin on the other service. A Colibri admin then redeems the code, which proves both sides agreed.

platform.description: The service the bridge connects to.

remoteSpace.description: The id of the server, workspace or network on the other service.

remoteSpaceName.description: Its name on the other service.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The bridge sent too many requests. Retry after the interval in the response headers.
